footer.tagline: Crewe Vagrants Squash and Squash 57 play at Crewe Vagrants Sports Club in Willaston, near Nantwich. Three courts, around 120 members, and players from age 5 to 89.

items.title: Crewe Vagrants established
items.desc: Crewe Vagrants Sports Club was founded in 1932 and plays from its ground on the outskirts of Nantwich, Cheshire.

items.title: Friendly
items.description: A sociable and welcoming environment for members and visitors.

items.title: Inclusive
items.description: Players range from age 5 to 89, with sessions for juniors, ladies and adults of every standard.

items.title: Active
items.description: Squash and Squash 57 are among the best sports in the world for health and fitness.

items.title: Team squash

items.title: Coaching
items.description: Develop your game through adult and junior coaching led by an England Squash qualified coach.

items.title: Choose your membership
items.description: Pick full adult, junior or family membership, and decide whether to pay annually or monthly.

items.title: Complete your application
items.description: Complete the club application with your membership and contact details.

items.title: Receive your account
items.description: Once your membership is active you will receive access to the online court booking system.

items.question: Can non-members play?
items.answer: Contact the club to ask about playing as a guest or renting a court as a non-member.

items.question: How do I book a court?
items.answer: Members book online through the club's booking system.

items.question: Can I pay monthly?
items.answer: Yes. Full membership is £28 a month and junior membership is £5 a month, as an alternative to paying for the year.

items.question: Is there a family rate?
items.answer: Yes. Up to three additional adults living at the same address receive a 50% discount on the adult price. Contact the club to arrange it.
